conventions: All GLBs: metres, +Y up, forward +Z unless stated, pivot bottom-centre unless stated. Textures inside GLBs are WebP (EXT_texture_webp) and geometry uses KHR_mesh_quantization - both handled natively by three.js GLTFLoader, no Draco/Meshopt decoder required. Paths are relative to app/public (serve as /real/...).

assets.gltf_extensions: EXT_texture_webp, KHR_mesh_quantization (both native in three GLTFLoader; no decoder needed)
assets.notes: Single skinned mesh, T-pose rest, faces +Z, feet at y=0, ~1.73 m tall (scale the root for height variety). Skeleton = the 65-bone Quaternius UAL rig copied from /models/anims.glb: identical bone names (root, pelvis, spine_01..03, neck_01, Head, clavicle/upperarm/lowerarm/hand_l|r, fingers *_01..03 + *_04_leaf, thigh/calf/foot/ball_l|r, ball_leaf), hierarchy and rest TRS (verified: translation error 0, rotation error <0.04 deg), so clips from anims.glb/anims2.glb play directly via AnimationMixer with no retargeting (checked in Blender with Idle_Loop, Walk_Formal_Loop, Sitting_Idle_Loop, Idle_FoldArms_Loop). Body proportions were conformed to that skeleton. Node tree: Armature > [mesh, root...]. Materials: skin (1024 webp), face_* (eyes/eyebrows/eyelashes), hair_* (alphaMode MASK, double sided), cloth_<asset> (512 webp; multiply material.color to recolour). Clone with SkeletonUtils.clone for multiple instances. Body faces hidden under clothing are deleted; any leftover torso skin uses material cloth_undershirt (flat colour matching the top). Eyebrows: darkened, alpha-boosted, MASK cutoff 0.2.
assets.source: MakeHuman / MPFB2 2.0.18 (Blender 5.3) generated mesh + MakeHuman CC0 asset packs
assets.author: MakeHuman community (assets: young_african_male, short04, male_casualsuit05, shoes03); generated by SNITCH project
assets.title: Gang member - young Black man, muscular, dark puffer jacket + jeans + boots

Skeleton = the 65-bone Quaternius UAL rig copied from /models/anims.glb: identical bone names (root, pelvis, spine_01..03, neck_01, Head, clavicle/upperarm/lowerarm/hand_l|r, fingers *_01..03 + *_04_leaf, thigh/calf/foot/ball_l|r, ball_leaf), hierarchy and rest TRS (verified: translation error 0, rotation error <0.04 deg), so clips from anims.glb/anims2.glb play directly via AnimationMixer with no retargeting (checked in Blender with Idle_Loop, Walk_Formal_Loop, Sitting_Idle_Loop, Idle_FoldArms_Loop). Body proportions were conformed to that skeleton. Node tree: Armature > [mesh, root...]. Materials: skin (1024 webp), face_* (eyes/eyebrows/eyelashes), hair_* (alphaMode MASK, double sided), cloth_<asset> (512 webp; multiply material.color to recolour). Clone with SkeletonUtils.clone for multiple instances. Uniform accessories (peaked cap + band + visor + cap badge, duty belt with buckle/holster/pouches, chest badge, shoulder patches) are original procedural meshes merged into the same skinned mesh, rigidly weighted to Head / pelvis / spine_03 / upperarm_l|r; materials uniform_cap, uniform_leather, uniform_badge, uniform_metal, uniform_patch. No real force insignia or text. Body faces hidden under clothing are deleted; any leftover torso skin uses material cloth_undershirt (flat colour matching the top). Eyebrows: darkened, alpha-boosted, MASK cutoff 0.2.
assets.source: MakeHuman / MPFB2 2.0.18 (Blender 5.3) generated mesh + MakeHuman CC0 asset packs
